'''Rodera''' is a [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]]. Before being taken ''[[gai'shain]]'' after the battle with [[Couladin]], she was ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]''.{{ref/book|5|44}}

==Activites==
Rodera is the ''gai'shain'' who serves tea to [[Berelain sur Paendrag Paeron]], [[Amys]], [[Bair]], and [[Sorilea]].{{ref/book|6|24}} She, along with [[Cowinde]] and [[Doilan]], serve breakfast in Amys' tent to the [[Wise Ones]].{{ref/book|6|25}}
